survivability.prose: Observed path EV is −0.31¢ per contract. The estimate is negative, but the finite-sample confidence interval contains zero. The specified book-price payoff produces +0.91¢ point-estimate EV at a 74.0% observed WIN rate under the specified 90/55 payoff, while the Wilson-transformed payoff interval also includes zero. At a hypothetical fixed allocation the capitalized observed-path mean is −$3.86. This is a model-assumed capitalization of the observed candle-path distribution, not executed P&L.
